bottom_line: In high-risk patients after an acute coronary syndrome, apixaban (5 mg twice daily) vs placebo added to antiplatelet therapy did not reduce cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or ischemic stroke (hazard ratio with apixaban, 0.95; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.80 to 1.11; P = 0.51) and increased TIMI major bleeding (hazard ratio with apixaban, 2.59; 95% CI, 1.50 to 4.46; P = 0.001).
implications: Based on the reported hazard ratios and event rates, these data support that adding apixaban to antiplatelet therapy after ACS did not demonstrate a significant reduction in the composite of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or ischemic stroke (0.95; 95% CI, 0.80–1.11; P = 0.51), while it increased TIMI major bleeding (2.59; 95% CI, 1.50–4.46; P = 0.001), including more intracranial bleeding (12 vs. 3) and fatal bleeding (5 vs. 0); because the trial was stopped early, the document states uncertainty remains regarding the effect on ischemic events.

major_points.text: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial comparing apixaban 5 mg twice daily vs placebo on top of standard antiplatelet therapy after recent ACS in high-risk patients.
major_points.quote: We conducted a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial comparing apixaban, at a dose of 5 mg twice daily, with placebo, in addition to standard anti- platelet therapy, in patients with a recent acute coronary syndrome

major_points.text: Trial was terminated prematurely due to increased major bleeding with apixaban without counterbalancing reduction in ischemic events.
major_points.quote: The trial was terminated prematurely after recruitment of 7392 patients because of an increase in major bleeding events with apixaban in the absence of a counterbalanc- ing reduction in recurrent ischemic events.

major_points.text: Intracranial and fatal bleeding events occurred more often with apixaban than with placebo.
major_points.quote: A greater number of intracranial and fatal bleeding events occurred with apixaban than with placebo.

criticisms.text: Because the trial stopped early with fewer ischemic events than planned, uncertainty remains about apixaban’s effect on ischemic events.
criticisms.quote: Because this trial was stopped early owing to the increase in bleeding events, with fewer ischemic events having occurred than the number planned, uncertainty remains regarding the effect of apixa- ban on ischemic events.
